hints.title: Digit Filtering
hints.text: Convert the integer to its character digit string and filter out every character matching zero.

hints.title: Base Conversion
hints.text: Parse the remaining non-zero digit characters back into standard integer representation.

hints.title: Empty String Guard
hints.text: If all digits were zero, return zero.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear time with respect to number of digits.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Arithmetic divisions without string conversion require extra loop state management.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Straightforward string digit filtering and parsing.
